terminal_or_classified_outcomes.result: All six cells completed technically with valid agent termination; no timeout or infrastructure failure occurred.

failure_traceability.result: Seven failed-check instances are visible, but two are clear verifier false negatives and two distractor-rejection instances expose a representation ambiguity.

temporal_separation.result: All six reports independently passed incident_start_utc, last_observed_utc and recovery_status.

normalization_policy.result: Two Pi responses contained one intact report object with surrounding text and were normalized exactly as predeclared; four responses were strict JSON.

human_calibration.result: Manual comparison found two new verifier false negatives, one blocking representation ambiguity and three genuine causal-chain failures.

human_calibration_findings.observation: Both reports list healthy customer-token evidence in evidence_ids and cite the unrelated admin-token event by exact ID in the same entry's reason. The verifier ignores reason and requires both IDs in evidence_ids.
human_calibration_findings.alignment_problem: The visible instruction requires direct evidence within the rejected-hypothesis entry but does not explicitly state that exact citations in reason are semantically invisible.

human_calibration_findings.observation: The report correctly negates order loss, checkout outage and production-notification failure, but raw substring matching treats those negated phrases as positive prohibited claims.
human_calibration_findings.alignment_problem: Lexical containment cannot determine whether a free-text claim is asserted or explicitly denied.

human_calibration_findings.observation: The report identifies payment-validation and adds the correct failing payment-node-03 component in parentheses. Exact normalized token-set equality rejects the compatible added detail.
human_calibration_findings.alignment_problem: A descriptive service label may contain correct component detail, while unrestricted subset acceptance could also admit genuinely broader or different scope.

candidate_attributable_findings.observation: Positions 2 and 5 omit the immediate zero-delay retry waypoint; position 2 also omits intermediate queue draining. Position 6 orders the edge error before the causally prior skewed-node rejection and omits the intermittent-rejection event.
Each response contained one intact report object and was normalized without internal repair. Semantic evaluation remained independent of strict transport compliance.

counterfactual_diagnostics.purpose: Identify specification and verifier defects, not rescore frozen outcomes.

required_repairs: Make it explicit whether only rejected_hypotheses[].evidence_ids count as attached evidence, or validate exact event citations across the complete entry.
Remove negation-blind substring matching from free-text unsupported-claim verification.
Use visible canonical scope identifiers or separate canonical service identity from optional component detail.
Retain the validated temporal, evidence-role, normalization, read-only isolation and timeout contracts.
Qualify focused positive and negative controls offline before another small confirmation.

interpretation_limits: The study cannot estimate reliability, quality stochasticity or latency tails.
Mini and Pi are complete deployed systems, not an isolated one-factor harness experiment.
The human calibration does not overwrite or rescore the frozen official 1/6 result.
